personality: 3 Editorial Mobile (con fusioni calde artigianali e tone-of-voice siciliano)
personality_one_liner: Un mercato digitale dei sapori autentici di Sicilia, dove la tradizione artigianale incontra il commercio globale in un'esperienza calda, visiva e senza tempo.

spacing.rule: Rhythm and breathing space inspired by Sicilian countryside and editorial layouts. Generous padding around editorial cards, compact density on B2B data tables.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky search and bottom navigation bar over scrolling editorial catalogs
Apply translucent terracotta/olive tinted glass on featured B2C hero cards and B2B contract status banners
dont's: Never blur body copy or dense B2B negotiation message logs
Avoid heavy blur on data tables and logistic quote comparisons

screens.name: Home / Discovery
screens.purpose: Immerse user in Sicilian heritage with featured artisan products, seasonal packages (Blood Oranges, Olive Oil, Cannoli), and direct producer links.

states.loading: Centered terracotta spinner with warm parchment background
states.empty: Illustration of ancient olive tree with reset filters button
states.error: Warm terracotta error banner with retry action

screens.layout: Vertical editorial scroll with sticky header search, full-bleed hero banner with gradient scrim, horizontal category pills, 2-column artisan product grid with real logo badges.

screens.name: Marketplace B2B
screens.purpose: Connect Sicilian producers with international distributors, wholesalers, and commercial agents for bulk orders and contracts.

states.loading: Skeleton rows for bulk order listings
states.empty: No active B2B contracts or offers found
states.error: Unable to load B2B marketplace. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Tabbed filter header (All, Bulk Wine, Citrus Pallets, Olive Oil Tanks), list of bulk listings with MOQs, negotiation status badges, and 'Inizia Trattativa' CTA.

screens.name: Logistica Centralizzata
screens.purpose: Aggregate shipments among producers and buyers to lower freight costs across Italy and export markets.

states.empty: Nessuna spedizione condivisa attiva nella tua zona
states.error: Errore nel caricamento della rete logistica. Riprova.

screens.layout: Route optimization map preview card, shared pallet pool list with fill percentage bars, quote comparison table from logistics partners, and 'Proponi Spedizioni' sticky button.

screens.name: Adeguamento Etichette
screens.purpose: Expert-driven regulatory compliance hub where producers get labels checked for export markets (EU, USA, Asia).

states.loading: Document analysis loader with rotating compliance icon
states.empty: Nessuna etichetta in fase di revisione

screens.layout: List of submitted label designs with status badges (In Revisione, Approvata EU, Modifiche Richieste), collaborator proposal cards, and 'Carica Nuova Etichetta' floating action.

screens.name: Dashboard Produttore & Admin
screens.purpose: Empower producers to manage autonomous catalog listings, purchase visibility booster packages, and admin curation.

states.empty: Nessun prodotto pubblicato o pacchetto attivo
states.error: Errore di sincronizzazione con il catalogo produttore.

screens.layout: Top stats summary (Sales, Visibility Boost, Pending Orders), active visibility packages carousel, product management inventory list, and admin approval queue.

hero_olive_oil.alt: Bottiglia di olio extravergine d'oliva artigianale siciliano

hero_citrus.alt: Arance rosse di Sicilia fresche al mercato

hero_cannoli.alt: Cannoli siciliani artigianali con ricotta e pistacchio

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to Personality 3 Editorial Mobile with Sicilian terracotta (#C05632), olive green (#5E6C3A), and warm parchment cream (#F6F1EB) surfaces.
Implement bilingual support (Italian + English) for B2B export markets with language switcher in headers.
Ensure every screen features loading, empty, and error states with full flex layout.
B2B negotiation flow includes simulated chat/offer counters and commercial agreement signatures.
Logistics centralization features shared pallet aggregation and freight cost comparison.
Label compliance section allows producers to upload label images and receive collaborator proposals.
Producer visibility packages allow boosting product listings with simulated payment checkout.
Zero tolerance for generic purple/indigo AI themes, emojis in system UI, or missing touch targets.
